name: whatsapp
description: Send WhatsApp messages via the WhatsApp Business Cloud API. Requires NLS_WHATSAPP_TOKEN and NLS_WHATSAPP_PHONE_ID.

to.description: Recipient phone number (with country code, no +)

manual.overview: Use WhatsApp when reaching users on their primary mobile messaging app. Best for time-sensitive alerts, OTPs, or customer notifications where high open rates matter. Requires WhatsApp Business API setup.

examples.description: Send an OTP or short alert
Send a shipping notification with link
Send a reminder to a European number

tips: Phone numbers must be in E.164 format without +: country code + number, no spaces or dashes
WhatsApp Business API has a 24-hour message window; after that you need template messages for first contact
Keep messages short; WhatsApp is conversational, not for long-form content
Verify NLS_WHATSAPP_PHONE_ID and NLS_WHATSAPP_TOKEN are set for your Business namespace
edge_cases: Recipients must have opted in to receive messages; unsolicited messages risk account bans
Number format errors (missing country code, wrong length) cause send failures
Template messages require pre-approved templates in Meta Business Manager; ad-hoc text only works within the 24h window
